requirements.text: The system should simplify the booking process for customers, allowing them to choose services, select barbers, and find available time slots.
Customers should receive immediate confirmation of their bookings.
The system should send reminders to reduce no-shows.
The system should maintain the option for manual bookings, integrating seamlessly with the current paper diary and phone call methods.
Each barber should have the ability to set their own hours and manage breaks within the new system.
The solution should align with existing workflows to ensure a smooth transition without disrupting current client interactions.
